name: The Dragon's Last Flight
source:
The Dragon's Last Flight is a fantasy visual novel game set in a world where dragons have become scarce and once-noble slayers sell their honor for profit. Play as Marius, a silver-haired dragonslayer who is contracted by a mysterious woman to slay what may be the last living dragon.

[From [url=https://storytellerkim.itch.io/the-dragons-last-flight]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《龙的最后​​一次飞行》是一款奇幻视觉小说游戏，背景设定在龙变得稀缺的世界中，曾经高贵的屠龙者为了利润而出卖自己的荣誉。扮演马吕斯，一位银发屠龙者，与一位神秘女子签订契约，去杀死可能是最后一条活龙。

[来自[url=https://storytellerkim.itch.io/the-dragons-last-flight]itch.io[/url]]
